title: VPC CIDR Planning for Multi-Environment
prompt: Design a CIDR allocation strategy for three environments (dev, staging, production) each in their own VPC. Ensure no CIDR overlaps and plan for future VPC peering between all environments.
hints: Plan subnet sizes to accommodate growth
Show that non-overlapping CIDRs enable future peering
Include at least 2 AZs per VPC for high availability
